<!--- Verify first that your issue is not already reported on GitHub -->
<!--- Also test if the latest release and devel branch are affected too -->
<!--- Complete *all* sections as described, this form is processed automatically -->

##### SUMMARY
<!--- Explain the problem briefly below -->
Variables can not be set when when all following conditions are met : 
       
- Variable is defined in handlers
- Task is delegate to localhost
- First host in inventory has failed

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bug Report

##### COMPONENT NAME
<!--- Write the short name of the module, plugin, task or feature below, use your best guess if unsure -->
handlers

##### ANSIBLE VERSION
<!--- Paste verbatim output from "ansible --version" between quotes -->
```
ansible 2.7.10
  config file = /opt/ansible/etc/ansible_env_nonprod.cfg
  configured module search path = ['/opt/ansible/library']
  ansible python module location = /opt/python-3.6-Current/lib64/python3.6/site-packages/ansible
  executable location = /opt/python-3.6-Current/bin/ansible
  python version = 3.6.6 (default, Aug 13 2018, 18:24:23) [GCC 4.8.5 20150623 (Red Hat 4.8.5-28)]
```

##### CONFIGURATION
<!--- Paste verbatim output from "ansible-config dump --only-changed" between quotes -->
```paste below
DEFAULT_HOST_LIST(/usr/gestux/dab9085/etc/ansible_env_nonprod.cfg) = ['/usr/gestux/ansible/inventory/hosts_nonprod', '/usr/gestux/ansible/inventory/groupes_nonprod.ini']
DEFAULT_MODULE_PATH(env: ANSIBLE_LIBRARY) = ['/usr/gestux/dab9085/ansible/library']
DEFAULT_TRANSPORT(/usr/gestux/dab9085/etc/ansible_env_nonprod.cfg) = paramiko
DEFAULT_VAULT_PASSWORD_FILE(env: ANSIBLE_VAULT_PASSWORD_FILE) = /usr/gestux/ansible/key/vault.txt
DISPLAY_SKIPPED_HOSTS(/usr/gestux/dab9085/etc/ansible_env_nonprod.cfg) = False
HOST_KEY_CHECKING(/usr/gestux/dab9085/etc/ansible_env_nonprod.cfg) = False
```

##### OS / ENVIRONMENT
<!--- Provide all relevant information below, e.g. target OS versions, network device firmware, etc. -->
Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server release 7.6 (Maipo)

##### STEPS TO REPRODUCE
<!--- Describe exactly how to reproduce the problem, using a minimal test-case -->

<!--- Paste example playbooks or commands between quotes below -->
test.yml:
```
#!/usr/bin/env ansible-playbook
---

- name: Patching ou reboot automatique via le crontab
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: no
  become: no

  tasks:
    - name: set a new fact
      set_fact:
        always: "always"
      changed_when: true
      notify:
         - h_verifications

    - name: run command
      command: uptime

    - name: h_verifications
      import_tasks: tasks/test_handlers2.yml
#----------------------------------------------------------------
  handlers:

    - name: h_verifications
      import_tasks: tasks/test_handlers2.yml

```

tasks/test_handlers2.yml:
```
- name: handlers - send page
  block:
    - name: Set fact
      set_fact: 
         send_notification: "need notification"

    - name: Debug msg
      debug:
         msg: "{{ send_notification }}"

  delegate_to: localhost
  run_once: true
```

the inventory is a composition of servers whose first is not reachable

Command: 
```
./test.yml -i /tmp/inventaire
```

<!--- HINT: You can paste gist.github.com links for larger files -->

##### EXPECTED RESULTS
<!--- Describe what you expected to happen when running the steps above -->
If the first server in the inventory file is right, the playbook run correctly.
```
$ ./test.yml -i /tmp/inventaire

PLAY [Patching ou reboot automatique via le crontab] ************************************************************************************************************************************************************************

TASK [set a new fact] *******************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
changed: [dlpriap346.unixdev.ca]
changed: [unknown_host.unixdev.ca]

TASK [run command] **********************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
changed: [dlpriap346.unixdev.ca]
fatal: [unknown_host.unixdev.ca]: UNREACHABLE! => {"changed": false, "msg": "timed out", "unreachable": true}

TASK [Set fact] *************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
ok: [dlpriap346.unixdev.ca -> localhost]

TASK [debug] ****************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
ok: [dlpriap346.unixdev.ca -> localhost] => {
    "msg": "need notification"
}

RUNNING HANDLER [Set fact] **************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
ok: [dlpriap346.unixdev.ca -> localhost]

RUNNING HANDLER [debug] *****************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
ok: [dlpriap346.unixdev.ca -> localhost] => {
    "msg": "need notification"
}
        to retry, use: --limit @/usr/gestux/dab9085/ansible/projets/patching/test.retry

PLAY RECAP ******************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
dlpriap346.unixdev.ca : ok=6    changed=2    unreachable=0    failed=0   
unknown_host.unixdev.ca    : ok=1    changed=1    unreachable=1    failed=0 
```

##### ACTUAL RESULTS
<!--- Describe what actually happened. If possible run with extra verbosity (-vvvv) -->

<!--- Paste verbatim command output between quotes -->
```
$ ./test.yml -i /tmp/inventaire

PLAY [Patching ou reboot automatique via le crontab] ************************************************************************************************************************************************************************

TASK [set a new fact] *******************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
changed: [unknown_host.unixdev.ca]
changed: [dlpriap346.unixdev.ca]

TASK [run command] **********************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
changed: [dlpriap346.unixdev.ca]
fatal: [unknown_host.unixdev.ca]: UNREACHABLE! => {"changed": false, "msg": "timed out", "unreachable": true}

TASK [Set fact] *************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
ok: [dlpriap346.unixdev.ca -> localhost]

TASK [debug] ****************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
ok: [dlpriap346.unixdev.ca -> localhost] => {
    "msg": "need notification"
}

RUNNING HANDLER [Set fact] **************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
ok: [unknown_host.unixdev.ca -> localhost]

RUNNING HANDLER [debug] *****************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
fatal: [unknown_host.unixdev.ca]: FAILED! => {"msg": "The task includes an option with an undefined variable. The error was: 'send_notification' is undefined\n\nThe error appears to have been in '/usr/gestux/dab9085/ansible/projets/patching/tasks/test_handlers2.yml': line 8, column 7, but may\nbe elsewhere in the file depending on the exact syntax problem.\n\nThe offending line appears to be:\n\n\n    - name: debug\n      ^ here\n"}

NO MORE HOSTS LEFT **********************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
        to retry, use: --limit @/usr/gestux/dab9085/ansible/projets/patching/test.retry

PLAY RECAP ******************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************
dlpriap346.unixdev.ca : ok=4    changed=2    unreachable=0    failed=0   
unknown_host.unixdev.ca    : ok=2    changed=1    unreachable=1    failed=1   

```

items.title: Can not set variables on handler with delegate to if first hostname failed
